# An entry that runs long

## The background

This entry says the same thing several times over, which is the failure the budget
exists to catch: the prose keeps explaining the demo instead of handing the reader the
demo, and by the time it reaches the link there is nothing left anybody wanted to click.

## The demo

Neither the URL below nor the alt text beside it is counted, so an entry cannot be
pushed over the budget by linking or by describing its own screenshot.

[Open it at the map](../../instances/main/#/view/map)

loses nothing at all by reading this instead of
